message.content:
**1) Visual medium:** Real footage (live-action video, filmed outdoors on a sunny day). No game engine, no HUD/UI overlays, no captions or title cards visible in any frame.

**2) On-screen text:** None readable in any of the 12 frames — no captions, signs with legible text, clocks, or titles. (There's a small white sign on a brown wall in frame 1, but the text is too small/blurry to read.)

**3) Visual arc:** A young man in a Harry Potter–style graduation/wizard robe (black with maroon shoulders), white shirt, and red-and-white striped tie appears to be "flying on a magic broomstick" across an industrial/office-park parking lot. 
- Frames 1–3: blurry distant shots of him airborne, mid-"flight," past a wall, utility box, and parked truck.
- Frames 4–6: clearer side views of him gliding/levitating past warehouses, palm trees, and parked cars, holding a broom between his legs.
- Frames 7–9: camera angle reveals the trick — a large flat gray panel (mirror/board) hangs below him, and in frames 8–9 a skateboard with red wheels becomes visible underneath the panel.
- Frames 10–12: the illusion fully breaks; he's plainly standing/riding a longboard skateboard on the asphalt, the mirror panel at his side, then losing balance/turning away in motion-blurred final frames. Location stays the same; bright daylight throughout, palette of gray asphalt, white/brown industrial buildings, green grass/trees, blue sky.

**4) Username/watermark:** None visible.

**5) Story guess:** A creator in a Hogwarts robe uses a hidden mirror panel and a skateboard to fake a "broomstick flight" illusion, and the contact sheet captures the moment the camera reveals how the trick works before he rides off/loses balance.
